lead.headline: No claim tonight; Downs for Lloyd if he clears
lead.deck: Lloyd is Green Bay's third back and Gadsden caught nothing. Tonight's answer is to spend no priority.
lead.body: MarShawn Lloyd is Green Bay's third running back, on a team averaging a league-worst 3.0 yards a carry, and Oronde Gadsden caught none of three targets. Correcting this morning: Kolar was never put on IR, so Gadsden's snaps could shrink when he's back. Claims process at 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City, overnight, and the right IPADE claim is none: priority never resets and nothing on the wire starts for you by more than a coin flip. After 01:00, if Josh Downs cleared, add him free for Lloyd; if someone took him, Michael Wilson on the same terms. The projection puts Golden in the flex over Tate by a point; take it. This week's opponent is Team 13, the Lamar trade partner, so that offer waits until Week 4 is final. Bloodsports lost 98.8 to 121.5 last week; the best lineup available was 116.0.

doFirst.headline: Claim nobody tonight; add Downs free if he clears
doFirst.deck: IPADE priority never resets. Downs for Lloyd happens only after he clears at 01:00. Golden into the flex is a coin flip decided by the projection.
doFirst.note: Downs, Wilson, Sadiq and the kicker and defence alternatives are all on waivers until 01:00 Wednesday: take any of them only as free agents.

roster.deck: One coin flip: the projection starts Golden over Tate in the flex (+1.0). No starter is in doubt.
